questions.stem: [Clerk / NTPC tier] Project TIGER was launched in India in:
questions.explanation: Project Tiger launched on 1 April 1973 at Jim Corbett National Park. Started with 9 tiger reserves; now 55+ reserves. National Tiger Conservation Authority (NTCA) is the statutory oversight body (established 2005).
questions.subject: Environment

questions.stem: [Clerk tier] India's first NATIONAL PARK is:
questions.explanation: Established 1936 as Hailey National Park (after Governor Malcolm Hailey), renamed to Jim Corbett National Park in 1957 in honour of the British-Indian hunter-turned-conservationist. Located in Nainital district, Uttarakhand.
questions.subject: Environment

questions.stem: [NTPC / CGL tier] Match the national park with its CHIEF fauna. A. Kaziranga. B. Gir. C. Sundarbans. D. Keoladeo (Ghana). List-II: 1. Royal Bengal Tiger (mangrove habitat). 2. Migratory birds. 3. One-horned rhinoceros. 4. Asiatic lion.
questions.explanation: Kaziranga (Assam) — one-horned rhino stronghold (population ~2,600). Gir (Gujarat) — ONLY home of Asiatic lion outside Africa. Sundarbans (WB) — Royal Bengal Tigers adapted to mangrove ecosystem. Keoladeo / Bharatpur (Rajasthan) — UNESCO site famous for migratory birds (notably Siberian cranes historically).
questions.subject: Environment

questions.stem: [CGL / PO Prelims tier] Consider the following about India's BIODIVERSITY HOTSPOTS. India has how many of the global 36 biodiversity hotspots entirely or partly within its borders?
questions.explanation: India shares 4 biodiversity hotspots: (1) Himalaya, (2) Indo-Burma, (3) Western Ghats + Sri Lanka, (4) Sundaland (Nicobar Islands). Each has >1,500 endemic vascular plant species and has lost >70% of primary vegetation — Myers et al's definition.
questions.subject: Environment

questions.stem: [UPSC Prelims / PO Mains tier] Consider the following about INDIA'S TIGER POPULATION per the 2022 All-India Tiger Estimation. 1. Total tiger population is around 3,167 (minimum estimate). 2. Madhya Pradesh has the highest number of tigers among Indian states. 3. Corbett Tiger Reserve has the highest individual reserve tiger population. 4. Ranthambore Tiger Reserve is in Madhya Pradesh. Which are correct?
questions.explanation: Statement 4 is WRONG — Ranthambore is in RAJASTHAN (Sawai Madhopur district). 2022 estimation: ~3,167 tigers (~3,682 as per updated July 2023 figure). MP leads in state tiger count (~785). Corbett leads in reserve tiger count (~260).
questions.subject: Environment

questions.stem: [CGL / PO tier] The CHIPKO MOVEMENT of the 1970s is associated with:

options.option_text: Forest conservation (hugging trees to prevent logging)

questions.explanation: Chipko (literally 'to stick / hug') — non-violent movement in Uttarakhand (then UP), women of Reni village led by Gaura Devi in 1974 hugged trees to prevent contractor logging. Sundarlal Bahuguna + Chandi Prasad Bhatt were other leaders. Inspired global forest-conservation activism.
